title: Post and Perimeter Two-Man Game
description: A wing and a post player work a simple two-man game — entry pass, cut, re-post — reading the defense without extra teammates involved yet.

content.objective: Read the post defender's help and choose between feeding the post, cutting, or resetting.
content.setup: A wing player and a post player work together against two live defenders.
instructions: The wing enters the ball to the post player on the block.
The wing immediately cuts through the lane, reading whether the post defender helps.
If the cutter's defender helps on the post, the post kicks it back out for an open shot.
If no help comes, the post works one-on-one for a finish.
coachingPoints: Enter the pass to the post player's target hand, not just anywhere.
Cut with real purpose — a lazy cut draws no help.
Post player should read the help before forcing a move.
commonMistakes: Cutting without actually drawing any defensive attention.
Post forcing a tough shot instead of kicking out to the open cutter's teammate.
Cutting without actually drawing any real defensive attention.
content.safety: Post defenders hold position legally without grabbing or hooking.
